prompt: PATCH on a note once let clients overwrite the note's id and creation date. What was the root cause and how was it fixed?

facts: Root cause: the raw request body was merged onto the stored note with Object.assign, so id and createdAt could be overwritten
Fix: PATCH accepts only title and body, any other field makes the request fail with 422 (strict), and store.patch copies only those two fields
Silently ignoring unknown fields was rejected because it hides client bugs

prompt: Notes used a different format for createdAt in the first iterations. What was it and why was it replaced?

facts: It was a local-time string in the form YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm
Minute resolution made notes created in the same minute compare equal, so ordering inside a minute relied on insertion order; local time is also ambiguous across timezones and DST
It was replaced by epoch milliseconds (UTC) returned as ISO-8601
